A1.justification: Both PDFs describe ContextGen and IMIG-100K and contain the main paper and appendices A–F. Text and rendered-page inspection support reliable comparison of equations, tables, figures, and appendix content despite repagination.

before.justification: v2 reports original benchmark evaluations, method ablations, qualitative experiments, and a DPO user study in Section 4 and Appendix B.

after.justification: v3 retains the work's original benchmark, ablation, qualitative, and user-study results, including Tables 1–8.

M1.justification: The FLUX.1-Kontext backbone, CLA/ICA layer allocation, position indexing, layout composition, and DPO procedure remain unchanged. Revised mask notation and additional documentation do not establish a changed algorithm.

E1.justification: Both versions use the same IMIG-100K training subsets and evaluate on LAMICBench++, COCO-MIG, and LayoutSAM-Eval. The added discussion of 3D assets concerns future work, not evaluated coverage.

E2.justification: Comparator membership is unchanged in the quantitative and qualitative comparisons. Although v3 newly mentions MS-FLUX in Appendix A.1, its evaluation already appears in v2's Appendix B.7 and Table 7.

E3.justification: Training settings, benchmark sample counts, metrics, baseline input preparation, and user-study procedures remain unchanged. Appendix C.2's added semantic-check description does not establish a revision to the experiments or their settings.

E4.justification: The layer-placement, position-indexing, and DPO ablations, flexibility and overlap case studies, and backbone/MS-FLUX analyses are retained. Appendix A.1 adds cross-references to existing analyses rather than new experiments.

E5.justification: Fixed-seed qualitative comparisons and user-study sampling information are unchanged. Neither version reports confidence intervals, significance tests, or repeated-run uncertainty estimates for the benchmark scores.

E6.justification: Tables 1–8 retain their numerical entries, and the qualitative displays are unchanged. For example, both report a LAMICBench++ overall score of 64.66 and COCO-MIG SR/I-SR/mIoU of 33.12/69.72/65.12.

T1.justification: Equations (3)–(4) replace piecewise notation with indicators and set unions. The explicit background fallback in the revised Equation (4) was already stated in v2's accompanying prose; the attention rules are restated without new assumptions, derivations, or proofs.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction, and conclusion retain the same contributions and claims about CLA, ICA, IMIG-100K, layout control, identity preservation, and state-of-the-art performance.

C2.justification: Appendix A.2 adds a conceptual rationale connecting CLA to heterogeneous-feature fusion. Appendix E adds zero-shot consistency priors and possible 3D extensions while retaining the existing identity-versus-flexibility limitation and explicitly identifying the current 2D scope.

D1.justification: v3 adds a project-code repository pointer in the abstract and newly describes MLLM-based reference-caption consistency checking in Appendix C.2. Conversely, Appendix B.7 removes the direct Grounding Resampler source-file link while retaining its implementation snippets.

R1.justification: Six references are added around multi-feature learning, semantic alignment, zero-shot editing, and 3D generation or editing. These provide limited additional positioning in the appendices; the main related-work survey and central novelty claims remain unchanged.

P1.justification: v3 makes localized prose and notation edits, revises Appendix A.1, adds acknowledgments, and updates the publication header and corresponding-author/contact information. The section hierarchy and most prose remain unchanged.

P2.justification: All eight tables and eighteen figures are retained with unchanged display content. Appendix floats are repositioned and regrouped, including Figures 13–14 and 17–18, alongside limited front-page and equation-layout changes.

improvement.justification: The project-code pointer, added curation disclosure in Appendix C.2, and clearer links to existing backbone controls in Appendix A.1 modestly improve documentation and navigation. The benefit is limited: empirical support remains unchanged, and Appendix B.7 loses a direct comparator-source link.
